observations: Used automatic transmission/gearbox with exposed torque converter, sitting among other used engines and transmissions in a parts yard.
Dirty exterior with grime and surface rust; no legible brand badge or model plate visible in photos 0, 1, or 2.
Flexible hose marked "V2-THR-5RE-11522" attached; this is not a gearbox identification number.
Watermark "POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC." appears across all three photos.
No receipt, warranty document, Ford logo, or Fusion badging visible in the images.

claims.evidence: No Ford or Fusion marking visible in photos 0-2.
Cylinder count cannot be determined from the transmission exterior.
Photos show a dirty used unit in a scrapyard setting.
External photos cannot prove internal history.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition; may be seized, damaged, or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the unit running on a test bench or installed and shifting through gears.

risks.risk: Fitment may not match Ford Fusion 4-cylinder; wrong bell housing, ratios, or electronics.
risks.proof: Clear photo of transmission identification plate or part number stamped on the casing.

risks.risk: Unit may have been opened, repaired, or rebuilt internally despite seller claim.
risks.proof: Clear photos of internal clutches, valve body, and assembly marks.

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty may not exist or may not cover this unit.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual receipt and warranty document matching the unit.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any metal identification plate or stamped part number on the transmission casing.
Video showing the gearbox operating and shifting through gears, either on a stand or in a car.
Photos of the original receipt and warranty document.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used automatic gearbox by type even though no model is readable, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen.
